description: Sends a campaign draft now, or schedules it for its time, named by id, with the estimate_id of a check made in the last 15 minutes; above 500 people, confirm_text is that count. It reaches every person the check counted, on their phones, and the messages cannot be unsent. It sends only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it sends nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve. The preview shows the campaign (its number, template and the value of each blank, saved audience, time and quiet hours) and who gets it now, who is left out and Meta’s list price, all read again when the token comes back: if any of it changed after the preview, the token is refused and a new preview is needed. Changing a single character of the arguments invalidates the token too. Only a person’s approval sends it: the credential alone sends nothing, through this tool or straight to the API. Five a minute and ten a day per workspace. Each campaign is on the Campaigns page of the Cosend dashboard.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

when.description: now sends the draft now; scheduled schedules it for the time the draft has, in its time zone.

name: send_campaign
title: Send or schedule a campaign
